workflow.name: building
workflow.objective: 构建仓颉编译器及其依赖，包括 LLVM、编译器本身、Runtime 和标准库

steps.name: 准备 LLVM
steps.description: Copy LLVM source code to the third_party directory

steps.name: 编译器全量构建
steps.description: Build the compiler with specified configuration

steps.name: 增量编译
steps.description: For faster incremental builds after making changes

steps.name: 编译 Runtime
steps.description: Build and install the Cangjie runtime
steps.command: cd ../cangjie_runtime/runtime && python3 build.py clean && python3 build.py build -t release -v 1.1.0-beta.999 && python3 build.py install && cp -R output/common/linux_release_x86_64/{lib,runtime} ../../cangjie_compiler/output/

steps.name: 编译标准库
steps.description: Build and install the standard library
steps.command: source output/envsetup.sh && cd ../cangjie_runtime/stdlib && python3 build.py clean && python3 build.py build -t release --target-lib=$WORKSPACE/cangjie_runtime/runtime/output && python3 build.py install && cp -R output/* $WORKSPACE/cangjie_compiler/output/

steps.name: 验证
steps.description: Verify the build by compiling and running a simple program
steps.command: echo 'main() { println("Hello, Cangjie") }' > hello.cj && cjc hello.cj -o hello && ./hello

troubleshooting.symptoms: Build fails with 'LLVM not found' or similar error
solutions: Check that LLVM was copied correctly to third_party/
Ensure LLVM version is compatible with the compiler
Check that all prerequisites are installed
Verify Python 3 version is compatible (3.7+ recommended)
Ensure sufficient disk space is available
Try cleaning build directory: python3 build.py clean

troubleshooting.symptoms: Linker errors or missing library errors
solutions: Install required system packages (cmake, ninja-build, python3-dev)
Verify all build steps completed successfully
Check that runtime and stdlib were installed to correct locations
Ensure environment variables are set correctly (run envsetup.sh)

troubleshooting.symptoms: Changes not reflected after ninja build
solutions: Perform a full clean rebuild: python3 build.py clean && python3 build.py -t release
Check that you're building the correct target
Verify CMake cache is up to date

troubleshooting.symptoms: Compiled programs fail to run with library errors
solutions: Verify runtime and stdlib were copied to output/ directory
Ensure library paths are correct in environment variables
Rebuild runtime and stdlib if necessary
